title: Fjord en Kayak
specs: Minimum kayak length 16’ with 2 waterproof crates, rudder and/or centerboard if bringing own kayak
includes: Wetsuit, paddling anorak, neoprene booties, poogies, hat, waterproof bag for camera
blurb: Guests participate in guided sea kayaking excursions of varying durations and age groups in the Saguenay Fjord Provincial Park and the Saguenay-St. Lawrence Marine Park. Trips range from family excursions for children aged 3 to 8, to adult excursions and full-day adventures. All necessary nautical equipment is provided, and outings proceed in most weather except severe conditions.
extraNote: Activity proceeds in rain; cancelled only for thunderstorm, very strong wind, huge waves
